review.why: Add data-quality checks with Great Expectations 1.x: expectation suites, checkpoints and Data Docs for DataFrames and SQL tables.
review.summary: Shows the GX 1.x in-code flow (data source, asset, batch definition, expectation suite, validation definition, checkpoint) for pandas DataFrames and Postgres tables, with two worked examples and guidance on severity, sampling and alerting.
strengths: States up front that GX 1.x differs from widely copied 0.18 tutorials, so outdated code can be spotted.
Runnable examples that validate a CSV before loading and gate a pipeline on a checkpoint result.
Practical guidance: passwords from environment variables, severity levels, sampled batches for large tables.
cautions: Covers GX Core 1.x only; code copied from older tutorials will not run.
Examples were not run here, and the Airflow example is a sketch.
Validation finds bad data but does not fix it; alerting has to be added separately.
